about.heading: Fired Up in Bahria Town
about.para1: Crust House started with one roaring wood-fired oven and a family recipe for dough proofed fresh every morning. No shortcuts, no frozen bases — just flour, fire and patience.
about.para2: Today our Bahria Town Phase 4 kitchen serves thousands of happy customers, but every pizza still gets the same treatment: hand-stretched, stone-baked at 900°C, and rushed to your door while the cheese is still pulling.

delivery.heading: We Deliver to Your Doorstep
delivery.note: Outside these areas? Call us — we’ll try our best.

items.q: Is there a minimum order for delivery?
items.a: Yes — Rs 500 for delivery orders. There’s no minimum for dine-in or takeaway.
Usually 30–45 minutes inside Bahria Town, depending on rush hours. We’ll always confirm your time on WhatsApp.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Cash on delivery, JazzCash and Easypaisa. Online card payments are coming soon.

items.q: Do you deliver late at night?
items.a: Yes! We’re open daily till 1:00 AM, and late-night delivery is active across our delivery areas.
Absolutely — extra cheese, extra toppings or no onions, just write it in the order notes and we’ll make it happen.
